item.text:
Implemented the cached blog posts page.

- [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1) fetches via `getPosts()`, uses `'use cache'`, `cacheLife('hours')`, and `cacheTag('posts')`, then renders the posts.
- [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3) enables `cacheComponents`, required for these [Next.js 16 caching APIs](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache).
- `npm run build` passes. Next.js reports `/` with a 1-hour revalidation interval.
